triage-a-support-inbox.input:
Charged twice. Please refund today.
Just saying thanks, no reply needed.
Order never arrived. Week three now.
Do you ship to Canada?

steps.name: 01-inbox
steps.command:
thinkthen filter 'Does this need a reply?' --lines < inbox.txt \
    | thinkthen annotate triage.json --lines

find-the-clause-then-check-it.input:
Either party may end this for cause.
Renewal notice is due 45 days ahead.
Fees follow the published index.
Ohio law governs this agreement.

steps.name: 02-clause
steps.command:
thinkthen find 'Which line gives the notice period?' < terms.txt \
    | thinkthen decide 'Is this notice longer than 30 days?'

screen-studies-for-a-review.input:
Survey of 900 remote workers on output.
Opinion essay on open-plan offices.
Interviews with 12 managers on hybrid teams.
Plan for a future survey of remote staff.

steps.name: 03-studies
steps.command:
thinkthen decide 'Does this report measured results on remote work?' \
      --lines --threshold 0.1:0.9 --details < studies.txt \
    | jq -r 'select(.value == null) | .input' \
    | thinkthen rank 'Is this close to a study with measured results?' --lines
steps.output:
Interviews with 12 managers on hybrid teams.
Plan for a future survey of remote staff.

code-open-ended-survey-answers.input:
Setup took ten minutes. Support helped.
Too expensive for what it does.
The app crashes when I upload a file.
Everything works and the reports are quick.

steps.name: 04-answers
steps.command:
thinkthen score 'How happy is this answer?' \
      'Unhappy.' 'Neutral.' 'Happy.' --lines --details < answers.txt \
    | jq -r 'select(.value < 1) | .input' \
    | thinkthen tag 'What is wrong here?' price speed bugs --lines

join-two-tables-by-meaning.input:
Card charges fail at checkout.
Export finished hours late again.

steps.name: 05-join
steps.command:
thinkthen decide 'Do these two describe the same problem?' --lines \
      --details < pairs.txt | jq -r 'select(.value) | .input'
steps.output:
Card charges fail at checkout. / INC-1 payment gateway returns 500
Export finished hours late again. / INC-2 nightly export queue backed up

steps.name: 05-team
steps.command:
thinkthen choose 'Which team owns this?' billing platform \
      --lines < tickets.txt

group-alerts-into-incidents.input:
INC-1 checkout returns 500 at payment
INC-2 search results load slowly
INC-3 nightly export ran late

steps.name: 06-alert
steps.command:
hit=$(thinkthen find --none "Which incident covers: $alert" \
      < incidents-open.txt) &&
    echo "$hit" | thinkthen decide "Is this the same failure as: $alert"

rank-the-inbound-leads.input:
We need 200 seats by next quarter.
Do you offer a student discount?
Please remove me from this list.
Our team of six wants to start now.

steps.name: 07-leads
steps.command:
thinkthen filter 'Is this a buying inquiry?' --lines < leads.txt \
    | thinkthen rank 'Is this buyer ready now?' --lines --top 2 \
    | thinkthen choose 'Which team should take this?' \
        enterprise smb --lines

screen-a-post-before-it-goes-up.input: This take is lazy and the author should quit.

steps.name: 08-gate
steps.command:
thinkthen decide 'Does this post break the rules?' \
      --threshold 0.2:0.8 < post.txt

steps.name: 08-why
steps.command:
thinkthen tag 'Which rule is in question here?' \
      insults spam offtopic < post.txt

check-an-expense-against-the-policy.input:
Meals with a client: up to $75 a head.
Flights: economy only, booked 14 days out.
Software: needs a manager's approval.

steps.name: 09-expense
steps.command:
thinkthen find "Which rule covers: $expense" < policy.txt \
    | thinkthen decide "Does this rule allow: $expense"

steps.name: 09-category
steps.command:
echo "$expense" | thinkthen choose 'Which category is this expense?' \
      meals travel software

build-a-morning-reading-list.input:
Postgres 18 ships a faster vacuum
Ten habits of happy developers
How DuckDB reads Parquet so fast
A new font for your terminal

steps.name: 10-reading
steps.command:
thinkthen filter 'Is this about databases?' --lines < feed.txt \
    | thinkthen rank 'Would an engineer read this first?' --lines --top 2
steps.output:
How DuckDB reads Parquet so fast
Postgres 18 ships a faster vacuum

split-a-scanned-packet-into-documents.input:
Invoice 7 for Northwind. Amount due $1,200. Page 1 of 2.
Invoice 7 continued. Line items and totals. Page 2 of 2.
Invoice 8 for Contoso. Amount due $310. Page 1 of 1.
Notice to all customers: payment terms change on May 1.

steps.name: 11-kinds
steps.command:
thinkthen choose 'What kind of page is this?' invoice notice other \
      --lines < pages.txt | paste -sd' ' -

steps.name: 11-gaps
steps.command:
awk 'NR>1 {print p" | "$0} {p=$0}' pages.txt \
    | thinkthen decide 'Does a new document start after the | mark?' \
        --lines | paste -sd' ' -
